offense.name: Spread half-court
offense.desc: Threes at a slow pace, few rim attempts

offense.name: Grind it out
offense.desc: Slow, few threes and few rim attempts: half-court sets and mid-range

offense.name: Pace and space
offense.desc: Fast, lots of threes, lots of passing

offense.name: Motion / inside-out
offense.desc: Paint touches and assisted makes, few threes (triangle, flex, high-post)

offense.name: Isolation / pick-and-roll
offense.desc: Fewest assisted makes: creators make their own shots

defense.name: Gamble and pressure
defense.desc: Forces turnovers, fouls, gives up the rim and offensive boards

defense.name: Disciplined / no-foul
defense.desc: Few fouls, protects the rim, ends possessions with the rebound

defense.name: Run them off the line
defense.desc: Takes away threes, lives with twos (switch / closeout profile)

defense.name: Aggressive wall
defense.desc: Walls off the paint and jumps passing lanes, concedes threes
